business_problem: give business teams a central platform for retail data so they could forecast better, optimize inventory, and use AI without a large engineering staff building custom connectors.
solution_summary: Etam uses Snowflake and Cortex AI on Snowflake to give business teams a central platform for retail data so they could forecast better, optimize inventory, and use ai without a large engineering staff building custom connectors. Etam centralizes business data from core systems, emails, spreadsheets, and retail operations on Snowflake using built-in connectors instead of custom point integrations. The shared platform handles transformation and analytics centrally, while Cortex AI helps extend insights and data access to users who do not want to depend on engineers for every request. Style, purchasing, retail, logistics, and other teams use the data for forecasting, customer recommendations, inventory optimization, and bespoke dashboards built on the governed retail data set. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and downstream access on one governed platform reduces data copying, simplifies operations, and gives teams a single trusted operating view for analytics and AI.
